title: UTF-8 Validation
statement: Validate whether each integer byte sequence follows UTF-8 leading-byte and continuation-byte rules.
code:
class Solution:
    def validUtf8(self, data: list[int]) -> bool:
        i=0;n=len(data)
        while i<n:
            x=data[i]
            if x<0 or x>255:return False
            if x>>7==0:count=1
            elif x>>5==0b110:count=2
            elif x>>4==0b1110:count=3
            elif x>>3==0b11110:count=4
            else:return False
            if i+count>n:return False
            for j in range(i+1,i+count):
                if data[j]<0 or data[j]>255 or data[j]>>6!=0b10:return False
            i+=count
        return True
